import json, os, subprocess, time, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

projects=[
    Path("/Users/steventran/do-again"),
    Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe"),
    Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary"),
]

def run(cwd,args):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False)
    return {"rc":p.returncode,"stdout":p.stdout,"stderr":p.stderr}

def sha(path):
    if not path.is_file(): return None
    h=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return h

def read_json(path):
    try:
        v=json.loads(path.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

rows=run(Path("/Users/steventran"),["ps","-axo","pid=,ppid=,etime=,command="])["stdout"].splitlines()
procs=[]
for line in rows:
    parts=line.strip().split(None,3)
    if len(parts)>=4 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit():
        procs.append({"pid":int(parts[0]),"ppid":int(parts[1]),"etime":parts[2],"cmd":parts[3]})

def descendants(pid):
    if not pid: return []
    out=[]; frontier={pid}; seen={pid}
    while frontier:
        nf=set()
        for r in procs:
            if r["ppid"] in frontier and r["pid"] not in seen:
                out.append(r); seen.add(r["pid"]); nf.add(r["pid"])
        frontier=nf
    return out

result=[]
for repo in projects:
    top=run(repo,["git","rev-parse","--show-toplevel"])
    if top["rc"]!=0: continue
    root=Path(top["stdout"].strip())
    key=hashlib.sha256(str(root.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    runtime_root=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/projects")/key
    control=runtime_root/"control"
    state=runtime_root/"state"
    runtime=runtime_root/"runtime/do_again"
    status=run(root,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"])["stdout"]
    head=run(root,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"])["stdout"].strip()
    branch=run(root,["git","branch","--show-current"])["stdout"].strip()

    requests=control/"automation/do_again/requests"
    receipts=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"
    reqs=sorted(x.stem for x in requests.glob("*.json")) if requests.is_dir() else []
    recs={x.stem for x in receipts.glob("*.json")} if receipts.is_dir() else set()
    pending=[x for x in reqs if x not in recs]

    ledgers=[]
    for rid in pending:
        ledger=read_json(state/"requests"/f"{rid}.json")
        if ledger:
            ledgers.append({"request_id":rid,"state":ledger.get("state"),"started_at_utc":ledger.get("started_at_utc")})

    browser=read_json(state/"browser_status.json")
    liveness=read_json(state/"liveness.json")
    rollout=read_json(state/"runtime_upgrade.json")

    daemon=[r for r in procs if f"--repo {root}" in r["cmd"] and "do_again.service.daemon" in r["cmd"]]
    daemon_pid=daemon[0]["pid"] if daemon else None
    kids=descendants(daemon_pid)

    outbox=state/"browser_outbox"
    outbox_ids=sorted(x.stem for x in outbox.glob("*.json")) if outbox.is_dir() else []

    result.append({
        "repo":str(root),
        "head":head,
        "branch":branch,
        "git_status":status,
        "runtime_key":key,
        "runtime_features":{
            "liveness":(runtime/"service/liveness.py").is_file(),
            "rollout":(runtime/"service/rollout.py").is_file(),
        },
        "daemon_pid":daemon_pid,
        "daemon_children":[{"pid":r["pid"],"ppid":r["ppid"],"etime":r["etime"],"cmd":r["cmd"][:500]} for r in kids],
        "pending_requests":pending[-20:],
        "pending_ledgers":ledgers[-20:],
        "outbox_ids":outbox_ids,
        "browser_status":browser,
        "liveness_state":liveness,
        "runtime_upgrade":rollout,
    })

print(json.dumps({
    "audited_at_epoch":time.time(),
    "merged_rollout_main_sha":"cbf5f56a41d3a61a33b4b3ea873d93461d4fc232",
    "ci_wait_lifecycle_gap":{
        "observed":"PR #11 CI completed successfully after prior chat stopped in waiting-for-CI state",
        "requirement":"native lifecycle must distinguish waiting_for_ci and resume once terminal CI state arrives"
    },
    "projects":result
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
